1.body:

23.subject: Urgent: Request for 1:1 Meeting Today
23.body:
Hi Kevin,

I hope this message finds you well. I need to discuss an urgent matter with you today and would appreciate if we could have a 1:1 meeting. Could you please let me know your availability?

Best regards,
Theo Appleseed

23.subject: Re: Urgent: Request for 1:1 Meeting Today
23.body:
Hello Theo,

Thank you for reaching out. Today is quite packed, but I can make time between 1:00 PM to 2:00 PM. Let me know if this works for you.

Best,
Kevin
